channel.title: ermolushka (blog)
channel.description: Alex Ermolaev's personal blog on systems programming, low-level engineering, Rust, LLM inference and security.

item.title: Adding CUDA to my Rust LLM engine
item.description: I added a CUDA backend to rvllm with hand written kernels, cuBLAS for matmuls, and a test that checks every step against the CPU path.

item.title: Optimization of the Rust LLM engine
item.description: rvllm generated 0.9 tokens per second from a 360M model. Profiling it showed almost all the time went to memcpy, not math.

item.title: rvllm - A Small LLM Inference Engine in Rust
item.description: A basic local LLM inference engine written from scratch in Rust, running SmolLM2 on CPU with continuous batching and paged KV cache, and where CUDA and Metal support fit in next.

item.title: Two Boxes, One Model - Playing With Multi-Node vLLM
item.description: A small learning experiment splitting an LLM across two GPU boxes with Ray and vLLM - tensor parallel vs pipeline parallel, and why plain ethernet ruins both.

item.title: Building a KV Cache Block Scheduler in Rust
item.description: A from-scratch PagedAttention-style KV cache block manager in Rust - reference counting, prefix caching via radix trie, LRU eviction, and copy-on-write for beam search.

item.title: Elephant VM - stack-based VM written in Rust
item.description: An implementation of a simple stack-based VM written in Rust

item.title: Memory Optimization Deep Dive Running 8B Models on a Single 4090 using vLLM
item.description: An exploration of quantization techniques and memory optimization strategies for running Llama 8B models efficiently on consumer hardware using vLLM

item.title: Data capture for ML endpoints
item.description: One of the approaches of how how you can add data capture to your ML endpoints

item.title: Python asyncio internals
item.description: A brief intro into asyncio internals in Python

item.title: Pratt Parsing intro for the compiler development
item.description: Pratt Parser intro and examples of implementation for the basic virtual machine

item.title: Snake game in Rust + Webassembly
item.description: Snake game written in Rust and compiled to Webassemly to run in your browser

item.title: Implementing ZIP unarchiver in Rust
item.description: A quick overview of a ZIP unarchiver tool written in Rust just for fun.
